title: Return Windows, Holiday Return-By Dates and Label Validity (Returns & Exchanges)
content:
These are the Returns & Exchanges time limits for each return type: how long after delivery a return may be started, the holiday return-by date, how long a return label stays valid, and the extension allowance on a return-by date. All periods are in calendar days.

## Return window and its anchor

| Return type | Window, non-footwear lines | Window, footwear lines | Counted from | Proof of sending in time | Marlowe Rewards window extension added |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Standard Return | 30 days | 30 days | Order's delivered date | First carrier scan date | Yes |
| Store Credit Return | 30 days | 30 days | Order's delivered date | First carrier scan date | Yes |
| Size Exchange | 30 days | 30 days | Order's delivered date | First carrier scan date | Yes |
| Instant Exchange | 30 days | 30 days | Order's delivered date | First carrier scan date | Yes |
| Gift Return | 30 days | 30 days | Order's delivered date | First carrier scan date | No |
| Quality Issue Return | 180 days | 365 days | Order's delivered date | First carrier scan date | No |

## Holiday return extension

| Return type | Holiday extension applies | Deliveries covered | Holiday return-by date |
|---|---|---|---|
| Standard Return | Yes | Delivered 1 November through 24 December | 31 January of the following year |
| Store Credit Return | Yes | Delivered 1 November through 24 December | 31 January of the following year |
| Size Exchange | Yes | Delivered 1 November through 24 December | 31 January of the following year |
| Instant Exchange | Yes | Delivered 1 November through 24 December | 31 January of the following year |
| Gift Return | Yes | Delivered 1 November through 24 December | 31 January of the following year |
| Quality Issue Return | No | (setting held at 1 November through 24 December) | (setting held at 31 January) |

## Labels and return-by extensions

| Return type | Label or QR code validity after authorization | Deadline extension days | Deadline extensions per return |
|---|---|---|---|
| Standard Return | 30 days | 7 | 1 |
| Store Credit Return | 30 days | 7 | 1 |
| Size Exchange | 30 days | 7 | 1 |
| Instant Exchange | 30 days | 7 | 1 |
| Gift Return | 30 days | 7 | 1 |
| Quality Issue Return | 30 days | 7 | 1 |

## Notes on the schedule

- The window is the same for footwear and non-footwear lines on every type except the Quality Issue Return, where footwear has 365 days against 180 days for other lines.
- The Marlowe Rewards window extension is the number of days of the returning customer's tier; this schedule records only whether the return type adds it.
- The holiday rows mark the Quality Issue Return as not taking the holiday extension; its holiday settings are held but have no effect for that type.
